Name: Updated Seasonal Outfits for Lunna Astray in Stardew Valle
Author: Rogvire
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
This is an update for Lunna's seasonal portrait and sprites from the mod: “[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley[/url]” by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz?gameId=1303]Rafseazz[/url]. While playing this mod, I noticed that although Lunna received a new portrait and sprite, her seasonal outfits still used the old portrait and sprite model, i assume it never recieved a update. So I used Paint.net to merge/adjust her seasonal outfits to match. I reach out to Rafseazz with a  message  about this issue to offer him the files or ask for permission to upload them myself. However, I haven't received an answer yet (which is completely understandable, as real life always comes first). That is why I am sharing this file now, so everyone can enjoy Lunnas new sprite and portrait in the seasonals outfit aswell. If Rafseazz contacts me and wishes for this mod to be removed, I will take this outfit replacer down immediately.

If you encounter/notices any "phantom pixels" or false portrait/spritepixels, please let me know and i'll fix the sprite/portrait in the mentioned outfits.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Drag the folder in your mod folder an replace the .png datas with it. I name the folder structure like the originals, so it shouldn't cause any issue replacing it. Else, replace it manually in Mods\LunnaAstray_3.4.14\[CP] Lunna\assets\ (or whichever version/folder name of Lunna you currently have installed).

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Just a replacer for the old portrait and sprites of Lunnas seasonal outfits.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley[/url]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]A big thank you and kudos to  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz?gameId=1303]Rafseazz[/url] and others, who were in any way involved in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna - Astray in Stardew Valley[/url] and giving the Stardew Valley community this neat gem of content. I claim[b][u] NO[/u][/b] copyrights or anything like that. [b]All rights are reserved to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz?gameId=1303]Rafseazz[/url] and the people[/b], who were involved in the original mod. I just created a update-replacer for everyone, who wants to enjoy Lunnas latest look in the seasonal outfits aswell.[/color]
